objective: Close the broad program's open middle with a lawful same-unit longitudinal route linking a dated or recalled material/health event to alternatives or adaptation, money/time trade-off, later outcome, and—where the source supports it—meaning, trust, action, or exit.
current_boundary: No PSID, UAS, HRS, or MEPS staged respondent file required for the next gated pass is currently present locally. Public documentation and field manifests are not treated as microdata evidence.

promotion_gate.rule: Do not promote an end-to-end finding when a required field is absent, only round-level context, or inferred across different units. Preserve unknown and structurally missing states.

ranked_routes.route: UAS Older Ages Monthly Events first pass
ranked_routes.why: Smallest documented event-first route: one uasid-by-wave row, prior-month event timing, medical expenditures, work/earnings, health, pain, and life satisfaction for adults 50+.
stop_if: stable key or wave timing fails
event fields do not overlap later outcomes
weights or missingness cannot be interpreted

ranked_routes.why: Largest planned many-family bridge for material room, paid work, unpaid care, time pressure, health, wellbeing, persistence, and reversal; it is not a dated remedy episode by itself.
stop_if: Conditions of Use are not accepted
valid denominators or variance method are unavailable

ranked_routes.why: Broader health, financial, employment, wellbeing, billing, access, and institution-perception route after the event-first structure passes.
required_inputs: UAS 537 and/or UAS 698 only if overlap and terms permit

storage_and_authority: Use only account-authorized files supplied for this pass. Do not download large archives by default, do not bypass login or terms, do not process UAS files without express written authorization, and retain hashes, field manifests, audit outputs, and compact derived records rather than raw respondent files.
handoff_result: The next turn with authorized files begins with structural and access checks, not estimation. If no authorized files are supplied, preserve this as an open acquisition boundary and continue only with bounded public comparators.
